name: Disneyland Hungry Bear Barbecue Jamboree Smoked Brisket or Pulled Pork Sandwich & Fries (Plain Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Hungry Bear Barbecue Jamboree (Bayou Country · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: The newly reimagined Hungry Bear Barbecue Jamboree slow-smokes tender beef brisket and pulled pork; ordering on a soft bun with BBQ sauce on the side and plain french fries (skipping the baked beans and slaw) makes a hearty park meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Smoked Brisket Sandwich or Pulled Pork Sandwich with BBQ sauce on the side, no raw coleslaw/pickles, and swap the baked beans side for French fries or mandarin-free applesauce.
watchOuts: Skip the BBQ baked beans, jalapeño cornbread, and raw cabbage coleslaw; DO NOT order the specialty lemonades (citrus trigger)
